dedupe_keys.name: scope a cross sectoral investment and dispatch model for future energy scenarios

description: SCOPE: A cross-sectoral investment and dispatch model for future energy scenarios is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Fraunhofer IEE (Fraunhofer-Institut for Energy Economics and Energy System Technologies). Cross-sector optimisation of deployment and expansion for analyses of the future energy supply system​ The SCOPE Path and SCOPE SD model variants are cross-sector capacity expansion planning models that provide an hourly breakdown of plant deployment throughout the year. They take into account all relevant interactions between the future electricity, buildings, industry and transport sectors. Coverage: Germany, United Kingdom, Ukraine. Time resolution: hour, 15 min. Spatial resolution: continents, national states, TSO regions, federal states, power stations. Software: Matlab. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
